name: TrustGraph
description: Mirror of trustgraph-ai/trustgraph, an open-source context interoperability layer: a Pulsar-backed processing platform that ingests documents, extracts entities and relationships with LLMs into an RDF/OWL hypergraph (N-Quads, named graphs), stores graph and document embeddings, and serves GraphRAG, DocumentRAG, SPARQL, GraphQL-over-rows, agent and prompt services through an API gateway (REST, WebSocket) and an MCP server. In the Notations Universe it is a candidate knowledge-graph substrate for corpus and archive nodes: workspaces, collections and portable knowledge cores are the units of context. It is an upstream mirror, not first-party code, and must not become the canonical state of the universe; the control plane journal remains authoritative.

capabilities.label: IAM service (global)
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/iam: whoami, list my workspaces, create/list/get/update/disable users, create/list workspaces, create/list/revoke API keys, admin password reset. Bearer tokens obtained here scope every other call to a workspace.

capabilities.label: Config service (workspace-scoped)
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/config: get complete configuration, list/get/put/delete stored flow definitions, list prompts, set system prompt, set token costs per model.

capabilities.label: Flow lifecycle and blueprints
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow: start/stop flow instances, list running flows, get flow details, list/get/put/delete blueprints (flow classes). Flows host every AI and query service.

capabilities.label: Document library
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/librarian: add document by URL or inline content, remove document, list documents (with criteria), start/stop/list processing of library documents. GET /api/v1/document-stream streams document content.

capabilities.label: Knowledge cores
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/knowledge: list/get knowledge cores (streamed triples and embeddings), store triples and/or embeddings, delete core, load core into a flow, unload core. Cores are the portable context units.

capabilities.label: Collection metadata
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/collection-management: list collections (optionally by tag), create/update collection, delete collection.

capabilities.label: Graph RAG and Document RAG
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/graph-rag and /document-rag: retrieval-augmented answers over the knowledge graph (entity/triple limits, hops) or over document chunks, with optional streaming.

capabilities.label: Agent service
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/agent: conversational agent with reasoning and tool use, multi-turn and streaming; can invoke configured MCP tools.

capabilities.label: Text completion, prompt templates, image-to-text
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/text-completion, /prompt (template expansion with terms/variables) and /image-to-text (vision model description).

capabilities.label: Embeddings and similarity queries
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/embeddings (text to vector), /graph-embeddings (similar entities), /document-embeddings (similar chunks), /row-embeddings (similar structured rows).

capabilities.label: Triples and SPARQL queries
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/triples (subject/predicate/object pattern queries) and /sparql-query (SPARQL 1.1 SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT, DESCRIBE) against the knowledge graph.

capabilities.label: Structured data queries
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/rows (GraphQL over structured data), /nlp-query (natural language to structured query), /structured-query (question to results), /structured-diag (detect format and generate schema descriptor).

capabilities.label: Text and document load into a flow
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/text-load and /document-load: push text or binary (PDF) documents with RDF metadata into a running flow's extraction pipeline.

capabilities.label: Invoke MCP tool through a flow
capabilities.description: POST /api/v1/flow/{flow}/service/mcp-tool executes a configured Model Context Protocol tool by name with parameters.

capabilities.label: Bulk import/export of cores
capabilities.description: WebSocket /api/v1/import-core and /api/v1/export-core stream triples and embeddings in bulk for backup, migration and sharing of knowledge cores.

capabilities.label: Multiplexed WebSocket
capabilities.description: WebSocket /api/v1/socket carries every service ({service, flow, request} envelopes) over one persistent connection; the MCP server and Python client use it.

capabilities.label: Prometheus metrics
capabilities.description: GET /api/metrics and /api/metrics/{path} expose Prometheus metrics for the gateway and processors.

capabilities.label: MCP: embeddings
capabilities.description: Generate vector embeddings for texts using the flow's embedding model.

capabilities.label: MCP: text completion
capabilities.description: Generate text with the flow's language model given system and user prompts.

capabilities.label: MCP: GraphRAG query
capabilities.description: GraphRAG answer combining knowledge-graph traversal (entity, triple and path limits) with LLM generation, scoped to a collection.

capabilities.label: MCP: agent query
capabilities.description: Run an intelligent agent turn with reasoning and tool usage inside a flow.

capabilities.label: MCP: triples query
capabilities.description: Query knowledge-graph triples by subject/predicate/object pattern with typed RDF terms (uri, literal).

capabilities.label: MCP: SPARQL query
capabilities.description: Execute SPARQL SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT or DESCRIBE against the knowledge graph.

capabilities.label: MCP: GraphQL rows query
capabilities.description: Execute a GraphQL query against structured-data schemas (rows) loaded into TrustGraph.

capabilities.label: MCP: graph embeddings query
capabilities.description: Find graph entities by vector similarity to a text.

capabilities.label: MCP: get full configuration
capabilities.description: Retrieve the complete system configuration as a nested dictionary.

capabilities.label: MCP: get config values
capabilities.description: Retrieve specific configuration values by type/key.

capabilities.label: MCP: put config values
capabilities.description: Update system configuration values.

capabilities.label: MCP: delete config entries
capabilities.description: Delete configuration entries from the system.

capabilities.label: MCP: list prompt templates
capabilities.description: List all prompt template IDs.

capabilities.label: MCP: get prompt template
capabilities.description: Retrieve one prompt template by ID.

capabilities.label: MCP: get system prompt
capabilities.description: Retrieve the current system prompt text.

capabilities.label: MCP: token costs
capabilities.description: Retrieve token pricing for all configured AI models.

capabilities.label: MCP: list knowledge cores
capabilities.description: List knowledge-graph core IDs in the current workspace.

capabilities.label: MCP: download knowledge core
capabilities.description: Download the complete triples and embeddings of a knowledge core.

capabilities.label: MCP: load knowledge core into flow
capabilities.description: Load a knowledge core into the active system/flow for querying.

capabilities.label: MCP: delete knowledge core
capabilities.description: Permanently delete a knowledge core.

capabilities.label: MCP: list flows
capabilities.description: List running/available processing flow identifiers.

capabilities.label: MCP: get flow definition
capabilities.description: Retrieve the complete definition of one processing flow.

capabilities.label: MCP: list flow classes
capabilities.description: List available flow class (blueprint) names.

capabilities.label: MCP: get flow class
capabilities.description: Retrieve one flow class (blueprint) definition.

capabilities.label: MCP: start flow
capabilities.description: Create and start a new processing flow instance from a flow class.

capabilities.label: MCP: stop flow
capabilities.description: Stop a running flow instance.

capabilities.label: MCP: list library documents
capabilities.description: List all documents stored in the document library with metadata.

capabilities.label: MCP: list processing queue
capabilities.description: List documents currently in the processing queue.

capabilities.label: MCP: upload document
capabilities.description: Upload a document (base64 content with metadata) to the library.

capabilities.label: MCP: remove document
capabilities.description: Permanently remove a document from the library.

capabilities.label: MCP: queue document processing
capabilities.description: Queue a library document for processing through a flow into a collection with tags.

capabilities.label: MCP streamable-HTTP transport
capabilities.description: `mcp-server` (trustgraph-mcp) serves the 31 tools over streamable-http on port 8000, forwarding the caller's bearer token to the gateway WebSocket (ws://api-gateway:8888/api/v1/socket); token validation happens at the gateway.

capabilities.label: tg-* command-line tools
capabilities.description: trustgraph-cli ships ~97 tg-* commands mirroring the API: tg-login, tg-create-api-key, tg-start-flow, tg-load-turtle, tg-load-knowledge, tg-invoke-graph-rag, tg-invoke-sparql-query, tg-show-graph, tg-graph-to-turtle, tg-export-workspace, tg-verify-system-status and more. Loading and flow commands are execute; show/invoke commands are read.

capabilities.label: Python client API
capabilities.description: Documented Python API (trustgraph.api) for flows, librarian, knowledge, config and flow services over REST/WebSocket, used by the CLI and by downstream integrations.

capabilities.label: OpenAPI 3.1 gateway contract
capabilities.description: Modular OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the API gateway (v2.4): global, workspace-scoped and flow-scoped services, kebab-case JSON fields, bearer auth.

capabilities.label: Bring-your-own ontology (OWL/Turtle)
capabilities.description: Ontologies in OWL/Turtle constrain extraction and retrieval; schema.ttl and ontology-prompt.md document the wire format for ontology-compliant hypergraphs.

metadata.graph_model: RDF 1.2 / OWL hypergraph as N-Quads with named graphs

relations.description: Inferred from naming and purpose, not confirmed by code: TrustGraph is a general knowledge-graph platform with portable knowledge cores, GraphRAG and SPARQL, which is the kind of substrate a Notations corpus graph would draw on. Neither repository references the other.

reference.spatial: Carries no native geography; entities may hold location metadata as graph triples.
reference.temporal: Flow run lifetimes, document processing timestamps and provenance/explain traces per extraction; no domain time model of its own.

corpus.holding: An RDF/OWL hypergraph extracted from ingested documents, with graph and document embeddings, organised as workspaces, collections and portable knowledge cores.

COR-001.note: Workspaces, collections and knowledge cores are the declared units of context.

COR-003.note: Extractions carry provenance and explain traces.

COR-006.note: Documents enter through the librarian and flow services rather than being written into the graph directly.
